Haar sphere decomposes into 48 equal order/sign chambers. Spherical coarea with explicitly computed circular-arc endpoints yields both density branches, the complete joint law, exact support thresholds and endpoint constants. Full standalone checker passed numerical normalization, 1600 direct convex-hull comparisons, 160000 independent Haar normals and onset diagnostics. Experiments are corroborative, not infinite proofs.

value.rationale: Determines a complete metric-combinatorial joint distribution for the canonical cube and octahedron under the same random planar projection. Gives a sharp six-vertex diameter threshold sqrt(8/3), distinct quadratic onset coefficients at sqrt2 and sqrt(8/3), and a square-root upper tail at sqrt3. A known binary face-count marginal does not determine this continuous geometric distribution; the metric question is natural and motivated by stereology and section/projection duality.
